title: parity
responsibility: Compares reviewed target profiles with observed release state, identifies missing candidate migrations, and checks route identity before and after a mutation.

inputs.name: assertObservation.target
inputs.description: Expected provider resource identifier.

inputs.name: assertObservation.actual
inputs.description: Provider read-back for the target environment.

inputs.name: assertObservation.now
inputs.description: Time in epoch milliseconds, defaulting to the host clock.

inputs.name: assertTargetProfile.expected
inputs.description: Reviewed target profile or expected signature scope for this verification.

inputs.name: assertTargetProfile.actual
inputs.description: Provider read-back for the target environment.

inputs.name: parityReport.config
inputs.description: Reviewed project or target settings for this operation.

inputs.name: parityReport.observations
inputs.description: Live read-backs keyed by deployment environment.

inputs.name: parityReport.candidate
inputs.description: Optional immutable release and destination whose applied migrations must be checked.

inputs.name: sameVersion.left
inputs.description: First provider observation to compare.

inputs.name: sameVersion.right
inputs.description: Second provider observation to compare.

inputs.name: assertResult.plan
inputs.description: Exact deployment attempt including target, release, predecessor and rollback information.

inputs.name: assertResult.actual
inputs.description: Provider read-back for the target environment.

outputs.name: assertObservation
outputs.description: No output. Success means the observation has the requested target and a recent timestamp.

outputs.name: assertTargetProfile
outputs.description: No output. Success means the observed profile matches the reviewed target.

outputs.name: parityReport
outputs.description: A redacted environment comparison, blocking differences, and a digest of the compared state.

outputs.name: sameVersion
outputs.description: Whether two observations identify the same release, runtime profile and routed target.

outputs.name: assertResult
outputs.description: No output. Success means the provider read-back matches the planned artifact or exact rollback target.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: The operation could not verify its input, target identity, or expected result.
